diagnosis.fix: Tag internal message containers and send exact ArrayBuffer payloads. Clone caller-owned requests; transfer owned results without detaching pooled/sliced peers. Nested byte results and native pointer integers are preserved.

limitations: Each guest transfer still requires a whole host buffer and is limited by actual host memory/Buffer capacity.
The Wasmtime helper is private and unshipped, tested only on Linux x64. General imports, descriptor ownership, cancellation, keepalive, reusable disposal and native packaging remain open.
The four upstream compile-disabled registrations retain their original exclusions. Full latest-release suite and standard-API coverage remain pending.
Native Windows/macOS and ARM64 installed acceptance remains incomplete. No remaining compatibility gap is demonstrated fundamental.
